prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t look up live ratings or current local listings from here, but I can help you find the best tanning salon in Pleasanton quickly and safely. A couple quick questions before recommendations:
- Do you want UV tanning (beds) or spray/tanning booths (sunless)?
- How far are you willing to travel? Any budget or brand preferences?

Meanwhile, here’s a short, practical plan and checklist you can use to identify the best salon quickly:

How to find the best salon
1. Search sources: Google Maps, Yelp, Facebook, Nextdoor. Use search terms like “best tanning salon Pleasanton,” “spray tan Pleasanton,” or “tanning beds Pleasanton.”
2. Sort/filter: prioritize recent reviews (last 6–12 months) and 4–5 star ratings. Read several recent reviews to see consistency.
3. Verify photos: look for customer photos of the salon, equipment, and spray tans to check results and cleanliness.
4. Check business info: hours, parking, walk-in policy, appointment system, cancellation policy.
5. Ask about safety & training: staff certifications, cleaning protocols, eye protection, machine maintenance.

What to look for in reviews and when you call
- Cleanliness and odor control (no persistent chemical smell).
- Modern machines (stand-up/hybrid/high-pressure) and clear pricing by minute/type.
- Experienced spray technicians, portfolio photos, and custom shade matching.
- Friendly, knowledgeable staff who ask about skin type and tanning history.
- Transparent pricing (single session, packages, first-time deals).
- Good ventilation and functioning shower/locker facilities for spray tan.

Questions to ask the salon
- Do you offer both UV and spray options?
- What type/brand of beds do you have? How old are they?
- Are your spray tans custom-mixed? Can I see before/after photos?
- What safety measures do you follow (cleaning, goggles, staff training)?
- What are your beginner or package rates?

Safety tips
- For UV: limit sessions, follow recommended exposure times for your skin type, wear goggles, avoid tanning if on photosensitizing meds.
- For spray: exfoliate, avoid heavy moisturizers beforehand, wear loose dark clothes after, follow aftercare instructions.

If you want, tell me whether you prefer UV or spray tan and I’ll:
- Give tailored search phrases and sample questions for that option; or
- Compare up to 3 salon names if you paste them here (I’ll help pick the best based on reviews/features you paste).
